pr_body:
Completes ADR 0139 first-release Editor working-copy coherency on the existing Draft PR.

- publishes the same immutable working-copy overlay into Scene View preview conversion
- invalidates only the preview composition when the overlay changes
- extends external-file conflict handling to specialized Animation Set and Material editors
- completes explicit-save and current-generation UI/debug behavior

The runtime remains Editor-agnostic; mutable ownership stays with the existing Editor sessions.
